R8-1: closed — in every policy a payment that was itself returned (a return points at it) never counts as credited or as making a debit good: the re-enrollment's make-good payment, the made-good relief's making-good payment, and the late fee's and settlement's debit card payment all exclude a returned payment.
R8-2: closed — every quantity only one factor uses is a binding of that factor and defined in its sentence (the closing returned-fee relief's reversed-payment lookup, the goodwill credit's late-fee due date); no plain binding is read by a single factor only or defined only by factor sentences.
